rules.title: Protect private workspace content
rules.requirement: A tool description must not instruct an agent to transmit private workspace content to an unrelated destination as a condition of using the tool.
rules.hard_deny_condition: The description directs the agent to send, upload, post, or otherwise transmit content it calls private, confidential, or workspace content to an explicit URL or email address.

rules.title: Preserve operator policy authority
rules.requirement: A tool description must not instruct an agent to ignore or override the operator's governing security policy.
rules.hard_deny_condition: The description directs the agent to ignore, disregard, bypass, or override the operator's security policy.

decision_authority.hard_deny: A deterministic detector match for a rule's hard_deny_condition quarantines the observed revision. No model output can downgrade or override it.
decision_authority.model: The model may recommend review or quarantine for one exact server revision, citing rule IDs and exact evidence spans. It cannot approve.
decision_authority.approval: Only an explicit operator action approves a server revision, including the initial baseline. An approval is bound to that revision and to this policy revision.
decision_authority.failure: Detector, retrieval, model, or validation failure leaves the revision pending review.

benign_changes: Wording, formatting, and schema changes consistent with the tool's purpose are not violations. They remain pending review until an operator explicitly approves the new revision.
integration_status: Policy must be uploaded and retrieved through scoped Senso integration during implementation.
